maps.area: Global state and persistence (scripts/g.gd, G.S save dict, settings, ranks, recovery-code feasibility)
maps.summary: The whole game state is a single untyped Dictionary, G.S (g.gd:277). load_game() (g.gd:318-353) builds it from default_state() (g.gd:296-316) and then shallow-merges the top-level keys parsed from user://save.json (g.gd:4). save() (g.gd:356-360) writes JSON.stringify(S) to that file synchronously. There is no backup, no atomic write and no error handling. About 60 call sites call G.save() directly. Versioning is a single int S.ver (currently 5) with two inline migrations, ver<4 and ver<5 (g.gd:336-353). Feature modules lazily add their own namespaced sub-dicts: v6_map, v6_story, v6_fx, v6_modes, v6_special, v6_heroines, v7_album, v7_room, v7_eggs, v7_daynight, v7_haptics and v7_event. Two of these are relevant to 0.8. First, G.RANKS (g.gd:123-130) with rank_of/add_rp is already exactly the plan's unified ladder (Бамбук → Нефрит → Жемчуг → Золото → Дракон → Небожитель), driven by S.rp, but only the main Path, daily and minigame play in screens/play.gd feed it. Second, the weekly tournament keeps a separate 5-league ladder (Медная…Лунная) in S.v7_event.tour.league, with 19 seeded bots out of 58 names. "Player level" S.player_lv is a constant 7 that nothing ever increments, and S.xp is accumulated but never read. There is no table-rank ladder (Ученица…) anywhere in this repo: the v08/table engine has no save integration, and "Ученица/Мастер/Наставница" exist only as etude chapter names. A full save is about 1.3 KB of JSON on a fresh install and roughly 7-10 KB late-game; deflate brings that to about 0.6-2 KB and base64 to about 0.8-2.8 KB. So a no-server "recovery code" of the whole save has to be a long paste/QR/share string, not a short typed code, unless a compact progress-only binary encoding is designed.

facts.what: const SAVE_PATH = "user://save.json". project.godot has no config/use_custom_user_dir, so on Android the file sits in the app's internal files dir (OS.get_user_data_dir()) and on desktop in ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Tile Waifu/save.json.

Android preset: version/code=8, version/name="0.8.0" (already bumped in commit 4b1b631), package com.tilewaifu.game. package/retain_data_on_uninstall=false, so uninstalling wipes save.json. This is why the recovery code matters.

No application/config/version is set, so at runtime there is no build version to read (ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/version") would be empty). The title text is hardcoded in txt.gd:16 "title.version": "версия 0.6 · без жизней и навязчивой рекламы" and rendered at main.gd:117.

Runtime globals. var S = {} holds the save. demo, demo_force_ssr, current_level, rng, time and offer_shown are not persisted. G.set_meta("pending_offer") (play.gd:1081, read home.gd:69) is session-only too.

_ready(): builds the ITEM map, calls _build_levels() (48 levels = 6 worlds x V6Worlds.PER_WORLD 8), sets demo from --demo and calls load_game(). G is the first autoload (project.godot), so S is loaded before the other autoloads' _ready.

default_state() returns these top-level keys: gems:1500, coins:2400, player_lv:7, xp:340, unlocked:1, stars:{}, owned:{start items: o_base, s_sakura, s_mint}, partner:"mc", outfit:{mc:"o_base"}, skin:"s_sakura", pity:0, aff:{mc:120,rin:40,hana:30,yue:0,nova:0}, daily_day:"", streak:0, sound:true, music:true, pulls:0, level_partner:"mc", tut_done:false, free10:false, newbie_left:20, newbie_ssr:false, guar:false, sr_pity:0, ex:0, pet:{day,n}, tasks:{day,pairs,levels,combo5,claimed[3]}, login:{n,last}, dailymap:{month,done[]}, pass:{owned,xp,claimed}, month_card:{until,last}, modest:false, cutins:true, voice:true, first_buy:{}, shards:{}, side:"f", rp:0, ver:5, yaku_seen:{}, blitz_best:0, next_great:false, intro_done:false.

Meaning of each top-level field. gems: premium currency, shown top right. coins: soft currency, shown top right. unlocked: count of playable main levels (max index+1, up to 48), written at play.gd:1073. stars: {"levelIndex": 0..3}. owned: {itemId: true}. partner: home heroine, also the topbar avatar (main.gd:455), set in collection.gd:123. level_partner: last heroine picked for a match (levels.gd:820, event_screen.gd:303). outfit: {hero: itemId} (collection.gd:219). skin: tile skin id (common.gd:315, album_view.gd:372). pity, sr_pity, guar: gacha pity counters (g.gd:494-540). pulls: total pulls. ex: exchange points (EXCHANGE_COST 120). free10: free x10 pull flag. newbie_left, newbie_ssr: newbie banner. aff: affection points per hero. shards: portrait shards per hero (SHARDS_NEED 5 unlocks the hero, g.gd:424). rp: unified rank points. yaku_seen: {yakuId: count}. blitz_best: blitz record. next_great: fortune pity. intro_done, tut_done: onboarding flags. pet: daily head-pats (3/day). tasks: daily quests. login: login-calendar day counter. dailymap: monthly daily-puzzle days done. pass: battle pass {owned, xp, claimed}. month_card: monthly card {until, last}. first_buy: shop first-purchase bonuses. gift_day: shop free daily gift (shop.gd:381, not in defaults). daily_day and streak: dead keys, never read anywhere.

load_game(): S = default_state(). In demo mode it injects demo values and returns WITHOUT reading the file. Otherwise it reads the file with FileAccess.open + JSON.parse_string, and only if the result is a Dictionary does it copy each top-level key over the defaults (a shallow merge: a nested dict from the file fully replaces the default dict). Migrations: if d.ver < 4, stars are re-keyed old*4 and unlocked rescaled (24-level to 4-per-world layout), then S.ver=4. If S.ver < 5, stars are re-keyed with V6Worlds.migrate_index (worlds.gd:161-164: w*8 + CORE_AT[s]), unlocked is remapped, S.v6_map={chests:{},seen:unlocked} is created, and S.ver=5. The migrated version is only persisted at the next save().

There is no handling of a corrupt or partial file. If parse_string fails (d is not a Dictionary), S silently stays at defaults, and the next G.save() overwrites the old file, so all progress is lost. There is no backup copy.

save(): does nothing in demo mode. Otherwise FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, WRITE) followed by store_string(JSON.stringify(S)): no indent, no null check on f (a failed open would crash on f.store_string), not atomic (no temp file + rename), and the file is closed only when f is freed. It writes the whole dict on every call. About 60 call sites, e.g. main.gd:132,222,242,330; play.gd:896,1105; levels.gd:636,822; shop.gd x8; room.gd x5; event_data.gd:272; ladder.gd:210.

JSON.parse_string returns every number as a float, so after a reload gems, rp, stars and so on are floats. That is why the code wraps everything in int(). Any recovery-code import must cast the same way.

RANKS = Бамбук(per 60, gems 150), Нефрит(100,250), Жемчуг(150,400), Золото(220,600), Дракон(300,900), Небожитель(400,1200), each with color and dark. ROMAN = [I, II, III]. This is identical to the 0.8 unified ladder. In-game name: 'Ранг мастерства'.

rank_of(rp): tiers 0-4 have 3 sub-ranks each, consuming `per` points per sub. The top tier has 999 subs titled 'Небожитель N'. Returns {tier, sub, into, need, title}. Reaching Небожитель takes 3*(60+100+150+220+300) = 2490 rp. rank_index = tier*3+sub.

add_rp(n): adds n to S.rp and, for each sub-rank crossed, adds gems (RANKS[t].gems on a tier entry, otherwise 50*(t+1)) to S.gems. Returns a list of ups. There is no floor protection: a negative n would lower rp below the tier start with no clamp, and nothing re-grants or claws back gems.

The only rp source in the game. In any play.gd mode except 'trial': rp_gain = 20 + stars*5 + hard*15 (main path only) + per-yaku rp (YAKU table g.gd:170-180). This applies to the main path, daily, blitz, zen and duel (play.gd modes). The same block also does add_aff(partner,10), task_add, add_pass_xp(100), S.xp += 40 and S.gems += reward. The tournament/event (event_play.gd), the arena modes (mode_play.gd: climb, etude, shift) and the riichi table (v08) give NO rp.

Topbar: rank title, rank bar and emblem from G.rank_of(S.rp). Avatar = S.partner portrait. A pink badge shows str(S.player_lv) (main.gd:458-460). Gems and coins are shown via _currency, with '+' buttons that go to the shop. Tapping the plate opens rank_ladder() (main.gd:265-305).
player_lv: default 7, NEVER incremented anywhere, only displayed in the topbar badge. xp: default 340, +40 per win in play.gd:1102 and event_play.gd:189, NEVER read. Player level is effectively fake.

Affection: S.aff[hero] is an int. add_aff(hero,n). aff_level = 1 + aff/100, so the progress bar is aff%100 (home.gd:165, collection.gd:106). Sources: play.gd:552 (+1 per pair), 880 (+15), 1099 (+10 per win); event_play.gd:184-186,276; mode_play climb +4, etude +3, shift +6; home.gd:186 (+5 per pet); story_scene.gd:191; eggs.gd:386 (+3); room.gd:228 (gifts/dates). It gates room scenes (room_data.gd:338) and adds a gem bonus of 5% per level above 1 (play.gd:243).
The affection plate is 268 px wide. Its label is "%s · симпатия %d" (home.hero_lv), 19 px, sized 186x28 with clip_text=true, which is why it renders as 'симпат…'.

Weekly tournament ('Медная лига'…). GROUP=20 (19 bots + you), UP=5, DOWN=5, TABLES=3. LEAGUES: Медная, Серебряная, Золотая, Нефритовая, Лунная. Each league has a bot skill range f, an idle chance, and gems by place [1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-10, rest]. PRIZES: weekly outfit for the top 3. NAMES: 58 hardcoded bot nicks. static var backend = null is a server hook used by group() and submit().

week_day() = d - posmod(d+3,7), where d = local-time unix day, so weeks start on Monday. st() lives at S.v7_event.tour = {week:"w<day>", start:<day>, league:int 0-4, group:randi()%100000, best:[3 table scores], runs, best_place, history:[≤12 {week,league,place,score}]}. When the week changes, _settle() runs lazily on first access: it pays gems/prize, moves up/down a league by zone, and appends a 'tour_end' item to S.v7_event.pending.

Bots are NOT stored. They are regenerated deterministically from hash(week|league|group). Each bot has events [(time fraction, points)] that are revealed as the week progresses (progress_of). group() returns 20 rows sorted by score, and the player's row is labelled 'Ты' with hero = S.partner. This pattern scales to the 1000 AI players without bloating the save.

Seasonal event. EPOCH 2026-11-16, 14-day cycles, 12 nodes. S.v7_event = {ev:{key:"ev<cycle>", def, cur (event currency), earned, nodes:{i:stars}, bought:{}, miles:[], daily, intro, bis, seen}, tour:{…ladder…}, pending:[report popups consumed by event.gd:116-122], owned_ev:[event outfit ids]}. When the event closes, leftover currency is converted at 0.5 to gems (event_data.gd:132-142). now_unix() adds the local timezone bias.

Settings popup. Flat bool keys in S: modest, cutins, sound, music, voice. Nested keys go through _v6_opt("ns.key"): v6_story.on, v6_fx.shake (also mirrored to v6_fx.flash) and v7_haptics.on. All read with default true when missing (main.gd:257,262). side: "f" (heroine side; the male option only shows a toast). The popup also shows the eggs-found count. Readers: sfx.gd:45,66,97; play.gd:590; story.gd:31; v6fx.gd:97 opt(); haptics.gd:40-45 (also reads v7_haptics.power, which has no UI); daynight.gd:43 reads v7_daynight.on (no UI).
S.v6_map = {chests:{"<world><mid|star>":true}, seen:int (map-reveal marker)}. open_chest adds gems, coins and shards, then saves (worlds.gd:148-157).
S.v6_story = {on:bool (setting), seen:{sceneId:true}}. mark() saves.

S.v6_modes defaults: climb_best, climb_runs, climb_miles[], etude_stars{}, shift_best, shift_runs, shift_served, seen[] ('hub'). Climb runs in progress are NOT persisted; they are passed via go() args (mode_play.gd:45-55).
S.v6_special = {seen:{specialKind:true}, events:int, gifts:int}.
S.v6_heroines = {duel_wins:{hero:int}, duel_day:{hero:date}} (written in duel.gd:369-380).
S.v6_fx = {shake:bool, flash:bool}, read via opt().

S.v7_album = {faces:{faceIdx:matchedCount}, claimed:{setId:true}, photos:[absolute file paths, max 40], new:[faceIdx], table:bgId}. Photos are PNGs saved to Pictures/TileWaifu or user://photos (photo.gd:420-437). The paths are device-specific and should not go into a recovery code.

S.v7_room = {gifts:{hero:n today}, known:{hero:{giftId:true}}, places:{hero:{placeId:true}}, photos:{hero:{id:true}}, seen:{sceneId:true}, last_mom:{hero:[i,i]}, day, invites (2 free/day), bought}. Daily fields reset when day != today.

S.v7_daynight = {greet:"date|phase"} (plus an optional on flag).
S.v7_haptics = {on:bool, power:float (optional)}.

The riichi table engine (ai.gd, mj.gd, round.gd, selftest.gd) never touches G.S or G.save(). It has no rank ladder and no persistence. The plan's 'ранг стола Ученица…Небожитель' is not in this repo (the only 'Ученица' is in modes_data.gd:132 ETUDE_CHAPTERS). docs/STATE.md says the 0.8 rank/league work was lost.

Paid boosters spend gems with no confirmation. Hint, undo and shuffle each check gems<30 and then do G.S.gems -= 30. Tray rescue costs 60. (The plan's '10 crystals' figure does not match the code: the price is 30.)

There are about 52 direct mutations of G.S.gems/coins scattered across modules, with no central add_currency(): g.gd:164,371; main.gd:328; play.gd:550,706,737,755,773,870,895,926,1048,1103; shop.gd:99,112,164,244,246,304,382,389; summon.gd:191; daily.gd:16,19,115; room.gd:327,413,441,571; album.gd:210; ladder.gd:250; event_data.gd:136,234-235,269-271; combo.gd:252; eggs.gd:209,387; specials.gd:192; duel.gd:376; mode_play.gd:271,500,802; worlds.gd:153-154.
Conflict: the plan says AI players get a small 'ИИ' marker in their card. STATE.md records the owner's later decision (2026-11-23) that AI players are shown WITHOUT a marker.

A fresh save serializes to about 1.3 KB of JSON (about 0.6 KB deflate, about 0.8 KB base64). A late-game save with all modules populated is about 7-10 KB of JSON; of that, roughly 3 KB is the 40 photo paths. Deflated it is about 2.0 KB, or about 2.7 KB as base64. Godot's JSON writes the reloaded floats as e.g. 1500.0, which adds a little. Size is dominated by v7_album.photos, v7_room nested dicts, v7_event (history of 12 entries, pending with Cyrillic bot names), stars (48), owned (about 38 ids) and story seen.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 1. Вход: player profile card (nick, random nick, avatar, play offline)
change_points_for_08.how: Add S.profile = {nick:"", avatar:<hero id or avatar idx>, id:<random 8-char>, created:date, offline:true} to default_state and bump to ver 6. Add a ver<6 migration in load_game for 0.7 players (intro_done already true but no profile): either flag them to see the card once or auto-generate a nick. Detect first launch with S.profile.nick == "" (or not FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH)). In _splash, show the card between the tap and V6Story.play("intro") (main.gd:124-133). A random-nick generator can reuse the ladder.gd:43 NAMES style.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 1/2. Recovery code (whole progress to another phone without a server) + profile shows code
change_points_for_08.how: Serialize a whitelist of progression keys, not raw S. Drop v7_album.photos (device paths), v7_event.pending, and the daily counters (tasks, pet, v7_room.gifts/day/invites, v7_daynight.greet). Then JSON.stringify, then to_utf8_buffer().compress(FileAccess.COMPRESSION_DEFLATE), then Marshalls.raw_to_base64, prefixed with a version tag and a CRC (hash) so typos can be detected. Expect about 1.5-2.7 KB of text: deliver it via DisplayServer.clipboard_set / share / QR, not by typing. Import: decompress (store the uncompressed length), parse, cast numbers with int(), run the same merge plus migrations as load_game (factor that into a merge_state(d) helper), save, and restart the screen. A short typed code would need a compact binary encoding (owned as an item-index bitset, stars at 2 bits x 48, and so on; about 200-300 bytes) or a server.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: Save robustness (prereq for recovery and 'no progress loss')
change_points_for_08.how: In save(): write to user://save.tmp, then DirAccess.rename_absolute over save.json, keep save.bak, and null-check FileAccess.open. In load_game(): if parse fails, try save.bak before falling back to defaults, and never overwrite an unparseable file silently.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 3. Единый ранг (one ladder fed by all modes, floor protection)
change_points_for_08.files: scripts/g.gd:123-166, scripts/screens/play.gd:1090-1097, scripts/v07/event/event_play.gd (~175-190, tourney finish), scripts/v06/modes/mode_play.gd (_climb_clear 257, _etude_clear 490, _shift_end 795), scripts/v08/table (round result), scripts/main.gd:265 rank_ladder
change_points_for_08.how: Keep S.rp and G.RANKS: they already match the plan's names and order. Change add_rp to accept negative n and clamp at the start of the current tier, i.e. never below the rank_of(rp) tier start, computed as the sum of per*3 over lower tiers. Allow losses only in senior halls (add a parameter). Call G.add_rp from event_play, tourney submit, the mode_play clears and riichi placement (+30/+10/-10/-30-style per the plan). Table rooms gate on G.rank_of(S.rp).tier. Remove or repurpose S.player_lv and S.xp: drop the player_lv badge at main.gd:458-460, or derive it from rank.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 4. Квартал и лиги (weekly league on the same tiers, 1000 AI, quarter rating)
change_points_for_08.how: Replace the 5 metal LEAGUES with the 6 RANKS tiers, and decide how the existing tour.league 0-4 maps in a migration. Generate a 1000-player pool deterministically from a fixed seed (nick, avatar hero, rank, pace) and do not store it. Store only the player's state: tour {week, group indices into the pool, best[], history} plus a new quarter key, e.g. S.v7_event.quarter = {q:"2026Q4", points, best_place}. Keep the existing backend hook (static var backend) as the future server slot. Quarter boundaries come from V7EventData.now_unix().

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 2. Profile screen: stats of all modes, league place, quarter place
change_points_for_08.how: Existing stats are scattered: blitz_best, v6_modes (climb_best, climb_runs, etude_stars, shift_*), v6_heroines.duel_wins, v7_event.tour.history/best_place, pulls, yaku_seen, stars, eggs found. Nothing counts wins, games or losses per mode, so add S.stats = {mode:{played, won}} incremented at the same win/finish points listed above.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 5. HUD header: profile (nick + rank) left, two currencies right
change_points_for_08.how: Header data comes from S.profile.nick, G.rank_of(S.rp) and S.gems/S.coins. Remove the S.player_lv badge (main.gd:458-460) and put S.profile.avatar in place of the S.partner portrait (main.gd:455) if the profile avatar should differ from the home heroine. The plate tap should open the profile instead of rank_ladder (main.gd:465-468).

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 6. Build version on title
change_points_for_08.how: Add config/version="0.8.0" to project.godot, matching export_presets.cfg version/name. Render ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/version") in place of the hardcoded 'версия 0.6' string.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 6. Affection plate not truncated
change_points_for_08.how: The label 'Имя · симпатия N' is clipped at 186 px (clip_text). Widen the plate (268 px), shorten the text, or use two lines. The data is G.aff_level(h) and S.aff[h]%100.

change_points_for_08.plan_item: 6. Paid hint confirmation
change_points_for_08.how: Wrap the G.S.gems -= 30 branch in a confirm popup. Optionally persist a 'don't ask again' flag as a settings key in S, defaulting to ask.

risks: The shallow merge in load_game means any new nested default (for example a new sub-key in S.profile or S.pass) is lost for existing saves, because the saved dict replaces the default dict wholesale. New nested keys need either per-module lazy st() normalization (the pattern used in worlds.gd, album.gd and room_data.gd) or a deep-merge.

A corrupt or truncated save.json silently resets to defaults, and the next save() destroys the old file (g.gd:330-335,356-360). A crash mid-write can trigger this. The 0.8 promise of 'no progress loss' needs an atomic write plus a backup.
retain_data_on_uninstall=false (export_presets.cfg:37): uninstall or reinstall wipes progress, so the recovery code is the only rescue path.

A full-save recovery code is about 0.8-2.8 KB of base64. That is not typeable, so the UX has to rely on clipboard/share/QR, or a compact binary format has to be designed. Importing a code must not carry device-specific photo paths (v7_album.photos) or pending report popups.
Numbers come back from JSON as floats, so a code round-trip or comparison must cast with int(). Also, JSON.stringify of reloaded floats writes e.g. 1500.0.

Unifying the tournament league (5 metal leagues, tour.league 0-4) into the 6 rank tiers needs an explicit migration, and it can change pending tour_end payouts and the history format (history entries store a league index).

add_rp currently pays gems on every sub-rank up. If more modes feed rp (riichi, tourney, arena), gem inflation grows. If negative rp is allowed, decide whether re-crossing a sub-rank pays again (currently it would, because only the before→after range is checked).
Settings default to true when the key is missing (main.gd:257,262), but 'modest' defaults to false in default_state. New settings keys must be added to default_state or they will read as true.
Plan vs owner decision conflict: the plan says the AI card has an 'ИИ' marker, but docs/STATE.md:23 says the owner decided on NO marker. Clarify before building the player card.
The plan says the hint costs 10 crystals, but the code charges 30 (play.gd:733-737). The confirmation text should use the real price.

Dates use local system time (G.today(), V7EventData.now_unix adds timezone bias). The week and quarter keys for leagues can shift if the user changes the clock or timezone, and nothing protects against clock manipulation.

maps.area: All rank / ladder / progression systems (mastery rank, riichi-table rank, tournament leagues, player level/xp, affection, plus side progressions)
maps.summary: The recovered v0.7 source has only two working ladders. (1) The mastery rank in g.gd: G.RANKS (Бамбук…Небожитель), stored in G.S.rp. Only Path levels and the daily layout award points (play.gd:1090-1097). (2) The weekly tournament league in v07/event/ladder.gd: V7Ladder.LEAGUES (Медная…Лунная, 5 tiers), stored in G.S.v7_event.tour.league. It has 19 seeded bots in a group of 20 and is fed only by the 3 tournament tables. The third ladder named in the plan, the riichi table rank «Ученица…Небожитель», does NOT exist in the recovered code or in the 0.7 APK. scripts/v08/table holds only pure logic (mj, round, ai, selftest): no screen, no lobby, no rank, and nothing outside v08 references V8* classes. The table rank lived in the lost 0.8 / riichi thread. The only «Ученица» string is the etude chapter name (modes_data.gd:132). The «player level» is fake: G.S.player_lv is a constant 7 that is never changed, and G.S.xp is incremented but never read. Affection is a per-heroine bond (G.S.aff, level = 1 + aff/100) that gates room scenes and skill speed. It is not a player rank and should stay separate. There is also a battle-pass counter (G.S.pass.xp, tier = xp/100, max 30). It is already fed by almost every mode, so its call sites are exactly where the unified ladder's points should be granted. Recommended unified design: keep G.RANKS as the single ladder (its names already match the plan exactly). Add one entry point G.add_rp(n, source) with floor protection and per-source stats, wired into every mode's result handler. Rebase V7Ladder leagues onto the same 6 tiers. Replace V7Ladder._bots with a persistent 1000-profile pool behind the existing V7Ladder.backend socket. Remove the player_lv badge from the topbar and move the rank_ladder popup into the profile screen.

facts.what: Mastery rank data: G.RANKS = 6 tiers {name,color,dark,per,gems}: Бамбук per60/gems150, Нефрит 100/250, Жемчуг 150/400, Золото 220/600, Дракон 300/900, Небожитель 400/1200. ROMAN=[I,II,III].

rank_of(rp): tiers 0-4 have 3 sub-steps of `per` RP each; the top tier has unlimited subs (999), titled with an Arabic number ('Небожитель 2'), not Roman. Returns {tier,sub,into,need,title}. Cumulative thresholds: Бамбук I 0 / II 60 / III 120; Нефрит I 180 / II 280 / III 380; Жемчуг I 480 / II 630 / III 780; Золото I 930 / II 1150 / III 1370; Дракон I 1590 / II 1890 / III 2190; Небожитель 1 at 2490, then +400 per step.
rank_index = tier*3+sub. It exceeds 17 inside Небожитель because sub is unbounded.

add_rp(n): mutates S.rp and pays gems for each step crossed: entering a tier pays RANKS[t].gems (Бамбук's 150 is never paid); a sub-step pays 50*(t+1). Inside Небожитель, steps past 3 compute t=mini(k/3,5) and s=k-15, so they pay 300 each. Returns an ups[] array. There is no decrease path and no floor logic.

class RBox extends Control. facts.what: Screen routing: 'play' uses scripts/screens/play.gd. 'arena' (climb/etude/shift modes) uses scripts/v06/modes/mode_play.gd, which extends play.gd. 'v7play' (event/tourney) uses scripts/v07/event/event_play.gd, which also extends play.gd. The splash launches the first game via go('play', {level:0, partner:'mc'}).

Legacy scripts/board.gd (class Board, which has its own hint at 331-337 and combo_window 3.0 at 28) is never instantiated. The live board is V6SpecialBoard extends TrayBoard. Its combo_window defaults to 5.0, and hint() at 601-610 highlights best_move() plus one free twin.

HINT charge: once the free count is used up (hint_n<=0), _hint takes 30 crystals at once with no confirmation (G.S.gems -= 30). It also increments boosters_used even when the hint is free. Nothing stops a second press while a highlight is already showing (highlights clear only on the next tile tap, tray_board.gd:380/387), so a repeat press charges another 30 for the same hint. Gems are charged before board.hint() is checked; a false result still keeps the charge.

Starting free counts: hint_n=2, undo_n=2, shuffle_n=1. The mc perk adds +1 hint, rin +1 undo, nova +1 shuffle. Fortune 'small' gives +1 hint, 'wind' +1 shuffle. V7Album bonuses, gifts (play.gd:874), combo milestones (combo.gd:235/240/245) and specials (specials.gd:360,418-429,648) add more.

Button caption: shows 'Base · N' while free uses remain, otherwise V6Txt 'play.price' = '%s · 30 кр.'. This caption is the only price indicator. There is no '10 crystals' anywhere in the code; the hint price is 30.
UNDO charge: with undo_n<=0 it takes 30 crystals with no confirmation and banks undo_n+=1. If board.undo() then fails (empty history), the paid undo stays banked rather than lost.
SHUFFLE charge: with shuffle_n<=0 it takes 30 crystals with no confirmation and always shuffles.

TRAY-OVERFLOW rescue popup: the first 'Вернуть 3 фишки' is free. After that the button reads 'Вернуть 3 фишки · 60' and one tap takes 60 crystals (no second confirmation). It also increments boosters_used and burns riichi. The popup's other buttons are 'Разложить заново' and 'В Чайную'.

Hint/undo/shuffle buttons: 112x112 JButtons at x=W/2-200, W/2-56 and W/2+88, y=H-172 (1108-1220). Their caption sits below at +110. The board area ends at y=H-186=1094 (board_rect), so the bottom tile row is about 14 px from the hint button, which explains mis-taps. JButton fires on release when the touch is inside its rect.

Subclass paths into the paid boosters: mode_play blocks hint and shuffle only in etude (882-892); climb and shift fall through to the paid super. event_play._booster_ok blocks paid boosters only in v7tourney ('В турнире только бесплатная помощь'); v7event falls through to the 30-crystal paid path.

Other crystal spends with no confirmation, outside this area but the same pattern: a summon pull charges cost immediately (summon.gd:181-195); buying an outfit (shop.gd:297-305) and the extra room invitation (room.gd:406-418) do the same. Rank-up silently grants crystals inside G.add_rp.

STAR RULE (story/daily): stars = 3 if fails==0 and boosters_used==0, else 2 if fails==0 and boosters_used<=2, else 1. Time is not considered. G.demo forces 3. Free boosters (perk/gift/combo) also count in boosters_used. The only on-screen info is the stats line 'play.stats' = '%d с · помощь: %d · переполнений: %d', which gives no rule. The stored stars are max(old,new) (1072) and the reward is cfg.reward.gems + stars*20 (1074).
The star formula differs between modes: the event uses fails<=1 for 2 stars (event_play.gd:175); etude uses undo counts (mode_play.gd:464-465); blitz/zen/climb/shift have no stars.

On the first clear of lvl 2 (index 2), a _summon_unlocked popup appears 1.6 s later. From lvl>=1, G.set_meta('pending_offer') makes home show the starter offer.

LUCK CARD / INTRO DELAY: in every story level except the tutorial (mode=='' and not tut), G.draw_fortune runs. _intro hides the board (board.visible=false), waits 1.1 s, runs V6BossIntro only on boss levels (stage index 7, so x-8; skippable, up to 3.3 s), then awaits _show_fortune. Its timings are pop_in 0.5, wait 0.7, flip 0.32, wait 0.4, wait 1.7, fly-out tween 0.35, about 3.15 s. The card root is MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE with no tap-to-skip. Only after that do board.visible=true and board.deal() run. The empty table therefore lasts about 4.25 s on level 1-6 (lvl index 5, not a boss level). deal() keeps input_on=false for another 0.012*N + 0.9 s. A fortune chip then shows at Rect2(136,132,260,44) for 4.6 s.

Tapping covered tiles gives a deny plus the bubble 'Её прижимают сверху...' (play.gd:663-668), which explains the critique that the arrow 'locks' tiles without saying why.

There is no rank or coins in the play HUD.

Event/tourney overflow is event_play.gd:136-160. Climb floor overlay with blessings: mode_play.gd:290-333. Etude result: mode_play.gd:490-547. Shift end: mode_play.gd:795-827.

maps.area: First launch flow, intro story scene, and the first-level tutorial finger
maps.summary: On a fresh install the game builds Home under the title splash. The player taps once on the title, then sits through the 'intro' story scene: 7 text lines plus 1 choice, so at least 8 taps, and 2 per line if they tap while the text is still typing. Then main.gd goes straight to play level 0, where the first tile tap is the first move. That is 10 taps minimum (title + 8 + first move), or 3 if the player uses 'Пропустить'. intro_done is set only in main.gd:_splash (line 131), after V6Story.play("intro") has already marked v6_story.seen.intro (story.gd:120). The intro text lives in story_scenes.gd:17-27. The tutorial (play.gd:_tutorial 469-500) is only a pink finger plus a bouncing arrow over board.best_move(), for up to 4 moves. It does NOT lock any tiles in code: what the critic took for 'locked' is the normal dimming of covered tiles (tile.gd set_free shader 'dim') plus the deny shake. No text explains the finger. The profile card belongs in main.gd:_splash right after the title tap (line 121), before the `if not intro_done` branch (line 124). Gate it on its own profile flag, so v0.7 players who already finished the intro also get it.

facts.what: Builds topbar/navbar/overlay/trans/finger, then calls go("home", {}, false) at line 72 BEFORE _splash() at line 73. Home is therefore fully built under the splash on first launch: home.gd:66-68 plays Sfx.say(partner,"greet") after 0.9s behind the splash, and the greet pool includes 'С возвращением! Я тебя ждала~!', even on a fresh install. Then G.demo -> run_demo, then _dev_args().

Returns early on --shots without --splash, or on G.demo. '--splash' forces G.S.intro_done = not '--fresh' (line 84-85). Creates sp Control (MOUSE_FILTER_STOP) added to main containing: festival backdrop, hero mc (interactive=false), logo (assets/ui/logo.webp), tag V6Txt 'title.tag', plum plate with 'title.tap' pulsing (lines 111-116), version label 'title.version' at Rect2(0,H-52,W,24) font 15 (line 117). Waits 0.8s then _wait_tap(sp) (line 119-120) = TAP 1. If not intro_done (line 124): kills pulse, fades logo/tag/plate/ver 0.3s, await V6Story.play("intro") (130), sets G.S.intro_done = true (131), G.save() (132), go("play", {"level":0,"partner":"mc"}, false) (133). Else Sfx.say(partner,'greet'). Then splash fades 0.45s and is freed (136-138).
Listens to gui_input InputEventMouseButton pressed on the given Control; --autotap=1 auto-advances after 1.3s.
DEAD CODE: an older hard-coded 4-line Маджонг-тян intro with its own box/nameplate. It has no callers (grep). It can be deleted or reused as the pattern for a short 3-line intro.

go() returns early if busy or (id == screen_id and args.is_empty()) (line 658). It calls await V6Story.before_go(self,id,args) (664) before building the screen. Consequence for a recovery-code restore: Home was already built at _ready with the old state, so go("home") with empty args will NOT rebuild it. Pass non-empty args or reset screen_id.
intro_done: false (line 315) and tut_done: false (line 306) are defaults. There are no profile/nick/avatar fields. A fresh state starts with gems 1500, coins 2400, player_lv 7, aff mc 120.

S = default_state(), then every key from user://save.json is overlaid (lines 330-333). The save is a single JSON dict, so a recovery code can serialize G.S (JSON.stringify) and restore by overlaying the same way. Version migrations run on 'ver' < 4 and < 5. Demo mode never saves.
For LEVELS[i] with loc 0, stage 0 it returns 'intro' (line 67), filtered by V6Scenes.SCENES.has.
loc 0, stage 0 adds 'first_win' (line 80-81).

When going to play with story args (no mode, no daily, no trial, has 'level'; _is_story line 86-87), it queues scenes_before(i) and sets pending_post = scenes_after(i) plus rp0. It filters out already-seen ids (102) and plays the rest with main.busy = true. When main.go is called from _splash after the intro, 'intro' is already seen, so it is not replayed and first_win is queued for after the win.

Adds V6StoryScene to get_tree().current_scene (main), awaits sc.play(id), then mark(id), which sets G.S.v6_story.seen[id]=true and calls G.save() (46-48). intro therefore has two flags: G.S.intro_done (main.gd:131) and v6_story.seen.intro (story.gd:47). _splash calls V6Story.play directly, which bypasses enabled() (33-41), so the story 'on' setting does not suppress the intro.

Full-screen Control, z_index 40, MOUSE_FILTER_STOP, fade in 0.35s. It iterates d.lines: a Dictionary goes to _ask, an Array goes to _say(who, text, emo). The loop breaks when skipping. Fade out 0.35s, then queue_free.

Header strip with chapter title 'Чайный сад · Дождь и вывеска' (G.LOCS[0].name + V6Scenes.TITLES). Cast heroes at H*0.64. Dialogue box Rect2(18,H-300,W-36,256) with name plate. Text label font 25, size (W-100,180), autowrap. '▼' more indicator. Skip JButton 'story.skip' at Rect2(W-214,36,196,60) sets skipping and tapped (104-107). choice_layer.

The typewriter runs for text.length()*0.02 s. It waits 0.2s, then for a tap. If the tap comes before the typing finishes, it completes the text and waits for ANOTHER tap (156-162), so each line costs 1 or 2 taps. Minor bug: more.visible is set true only AFTER the tap (162), and the next _say hides it again (144), so '▼' is effectively never shown while the game waits for input.

Choice buttons are stacked above the box, gold for the first option and rose for the second. A pick calls G.add_aff(who, o[2]) + G.save(), a float text 'story.aff', and then _say(who, o[1]) (one more tap). On skip no affection is given.

maps.area: Event (2-week ivent) and weekly tournament: scripts/v07/event/{event.gd, event_data.gd, ladder.gd, tourney_screen.gd, event_screen.gd, event_play.gd}
maps.summary:
I read all six event files in full, plus the code they touch in main.gd, common.gd, play.gd, home.gd and g.gd. The weekly tournament is V7Ladder (ladder.gd, about 260 lines). Each week the player gets a group of 19 bots drawn from a fixed list of 58 names.

**Why the group shows dashes.** A bot's score is a step function: 1–6 lump "events" placed at random fractions of the week. The row prints "—" whenever a score is 0. I simulated the bot code in Python. In the Copper league about 90% of bots are still at 0 at Monday noon, 80% after day 1 and 60% after day 2. About 15% (3 of 19) never score all week, because idle bots get 0–1 tables. Today, 2026-11-23, is a Monday, so the group is almost all dashes. When the player also has 0, the tie-break puts "Ты" at #1.

**Weekly reset.** It is lazy: `st()` compares the week key with `week_day()` (Monday 00:00 local time, from the system clock plus the time-zone bias). On a change it settles the old week, then gives rewards, promotion or demotion, and a pending "Итоги недели" popup. The event uses EPOCH 2026-11-16 (a Monday) with 14-day cycles, so every event end falls on a tournament week end.

**Leagues.** There are 5 leagues (Медная…Лунная), separate from G.RANKS (Бамбук…Небожитель). Tournament and event play award no rank points (РО): event_play overrides `_on_clear`.

**Header and back button.** Both screens call `show_chrome(true, true)`: the global topbar and navbar stay, and there is no back button or screen title bar. You leave through the navbar or the result-overlay buttons. Nothing handles Android back.

**Window over window.** Popups go into `main.overlay`, which is above the topbar, so every popup darkens the header. The event intro popup and the pending-result popup open on timers (0.5 s and 1.0 s) and don't check whether a popup is already open. If the player taps a table or "?" before the timer fires, a second popup stacks on the first.

**Where 1000 AI players plug in.** `V7Ladder` already has a hook, `static var backend` (ladder.gd:49), used by `group()` (ladder.gd:177-180) and `submit()` (ladder.gd:208-209). A deterministic population module can sit behind that hook. `_bots`, `_bot_score`, `group`, `st`, `_settle`, `zone`, `place_gems` and `LEAGUES` need changes, plus the three screens/popups that render rows and league names. Details are in change_points.

facts.what: Routing: SCREENS maps 'v7event' to event_screen.gd, 'v7tourney' to tourney_screen.gd and 'v7play' to event_play.gd. V7Event (event.gd) is an autoload. The only external entry is home.gd:125 V7Event.home_cards(self, main).
Unlock gate: is_open() is true when G.S.unlocked >= UNLOCK_AT (4), or with --event_open=1. The same gate hides BOTH the event card and the tournament card on home.

Home cards: c1 is the event card at Rect2(W-214, y, 198, 156), with y=586 if a second banner exists, else 410. It shows a ×2 badge when the first play of the day is unused. c2 is the tournament card at y+168 with sub-text '#place · L.short' when my_score>0, else the league name. Tapping goes to v7event / v7tourney. Then show_pending(home).

Time source: now_unix() = Time.get_unix_time_from_system() + time-zone bias*60 (local wall clock, no server, so a player can cheat by changing the clock). Dev override: --event_now=YYYY-MM-DD[THH:MM:SS] (date only means 12:00). day_of = floor(unix/86400).

Week math: week_day() = d - posmod(d+3, 7), the local Monday's day number (I checked: 2026-11-16 → 20773, 2026-11-23 → 20780, both Mondays). week_key = 'w<day>'. progress_of(t) = clamp((now - start*86400)/(7*86400)). left_secs = (week_day+7)*86400 - now. Rules text says Monday to Sunday.

Weekly reset is lazy, inside V7Ladder.st(). If t.week != current week key it calls _settle(r, t) (only when an old week exists), then creates t = {week, start, league, group: randi()%100000, best:[0,0,0], runs:0, best_place:0, history}. Skipped weeks are not settled one by one: only the last stored week is. t.group uses the global randi(), so it is not deterministic.

Storage: everything is in G.S.v7_event = {ev:{...}, tour:{...}, pending:[], owned_ev:[]}, created by V7EventData.root(). Saved by G.save() as JSON at user://save.json. G.default_state has no v7_event key; it is created lazily.

Group of 20: GROUP=20, UP=5, DOWN=5, TABLES=3. _bots(t): RandomNumberGenerator seeded with hash('%s|%d|%d' % [t.week, league, group]). It picks 19 names without replacement from NAMES (58 unique hard-coded handles, e.g. 'Сакура_77', 'КотЧай', 'Тануки'). Avatar is a random heroine from G.HERO_ORDER (5 portraits), so bots look like the heroines. There is no id, no profile and no AI flag.

Bot pacing: per league, skill factor f in L.f[0..1] and idle chance L.idle (Copper 0.3 … Moon 0.06). A non-idle bot gets 3 tables; an idle bot gets randi_range(0,1) tables at half points. 'Early' bots post at progress 0.02-0.55, others at 0.25-0.97. Each table is worth table_par*f*U(0.86,1.08); 35% are split into two events (a later +5-15% improvement). So each bot has 0-6 discrete jumps per week.

Dashes: _bot_score sums only events with time <= progress, and _row prints '—' when score == 0. Python port of the Copper logic (idle 0.3), share of bots at 0: day 0.25 → 97%, day 0.5 → 90%, day 1 → 80%, day 2 → 60%, day 3 → 38%, day 4 → 25%, week end → 15%. The last figure is permanent: idle bots with 0 tables.

group(t, prog): if backend has group() and returns a non-empty Array, that is used. Otherwise it builds rows {name, hero, score, me} for the bots plus {name:'Ты', hero:G.S.partner, score:my_score(t), me:true}, sorted by score desc with the tie broken in favour of me. At week start the player is listed #1 with '—'. place_of returns the 1-based index of me.

Player score: my_score = sum of t.best[0..2] (best run per table). submit(k, score) records the run, updates best, computes place before and after (2× group()), stores best_place, calls backend.submit(t, k, score, best) if present, and saves.

Tournament tables: table_cfg(k, start_day) is deterministic per week (seed = start_day*131 + k*7919 + 17; shape and mechanics rotate by week index mod 4). table_par = pairs*(PAIR+COMBO*2) + CLEAR + CLEAN + TIME/3, where pairs come from TrayBoard.gen_layout (cached in _par_cache). Scoring: PAIR 10, COMBO +4 per pair in the chain (cap 10), GOLD 20, CLEAR 400, TIME up to 300 minus 2/s, CLEAN 150. BOOSTER −40 and OVERFLOW −150; the third overflow ends the run. Only free boosters are allowed.

Leagues: 5 entries (Медная, Серебряная, Золотая, Нефритовая, Лунная), each with short name, color, bot f range, idle, and gems for places [1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-10, rest]. These are unrelated to G.RANKS (Бамбук, Нефрит, Жемчуг, Золото, Дракон, Небожитель with colors at g.gd:123-130). zone(): place <= 5 means up (unless top league), place > 15 means down (unless bottom league).

Weekly settle (_settle): if my_score <= 0 the league is kept and there are no rewards and no history entry. Otherwise: place in group(t, 1.0); gems = place_gems; the prize outfit (PRIZES = ['h_winter','r_yukata','o_cozy','n_offline'], index (start_day/7) mod 4) is given to the top 3, or +300 gems if already owned. G.S.gems is credited. League moves ±1. history gets {week, league, place, score}, capped at 12 entries. A pending {type:'tour_end', ...} is appended.

Week-result popup: _tour_result builds a Common.popup 'Итоги недели' (h=660) with the big place, the league, promotion/demotion text, a gems chip, and the prize art or a tip. Its button 'К турниру' does main.go('v7tourney'). When already on v7tourney, go() returns early (same id and empty args), so the button only closes the popup.

show_pending(node, main) waits 1.0 s, then pops ONE pending item and shows _tour_result or _event_result. It is called from home_cards, the tourney screen build and the event screen build. On the same Monday that a 14-day event ends, the week also ends: EPOCH is a Monday and DAYS=14. Both items are queued: home_cards calls V7EventData.st() (event_end) before V7Ladder.st() (tour_end), and they show on successive screen visits.

Event cycle: EPOCH '2026-11-16', DAYS=14. cycle = floor((today - epoch)/14). There are 5 EVENTS (yue, nova, rin, hana, mc) rotating posmod(cycle, 5); key 'ev<cycle>'. left_secs runs to the end of the cycle. A new cycle runs _close_event: leftover currency × LEFTOVER_RATE 0.5 converts to gems, and a pending event_end is queued.

Event rewards: 12 nodes, BOSS_NODES [3, 7, 11], played in order (node_open). clear_reward: first clear = 60+12i (+60 for a boss), replay = 36+4*min(i,11), +10 per star. +50% with the event heroine. The first event play of the day doubles the total. MILES are cumulative 'earned' milestones (300→100 gems … 3200→500 gems). SHOP: limited outfit 1800, shard 150 ×5, 100 gems for 120 ×10, 1000 coins for 60 ×10. Clearing also gives affection (+10, or +20 with the heroine), the 'levels' task, pass xp 100 and xp 40. No rp.

Neither the tournament nor the event feeds the unified rank: event_play overrides _on_clear for its modes, so play.gd's rp block (rp_gain, G.add_rp) never runs. Tournament gives the 'levels' task, pass xp 80 and +5 affection only.

Tourney screen layout (720×1280): topbar and navbar visible (show_chrome(true, true)). Header card Rect2(16,124,W-32,190) with the title 'Турнир недели' at (22,14), the league pill, 'До конца недели', big place '#N' or '—', 'N очков' or 'ещё не играла', and a '?' button at card bottom-right → rules(). Prize row y=326..438. Three table cards y=450..610 → main.go('v7play', {mode:'v7tourney', table:k}). Group board frame y=624..H-140 with the label 'Группа · 20 игроков'. ScrollContainer rows are 64 px with separation 6, plus 26 px divider rows for the promotion and demotion zones. The scroll offset (me_i-3)*70 ignores the dividers.

_row(r, place, league): place number, Common.avatar(r.hero) (heroine portrait only), name (clip at 300 px), trophy for top 3 with score>0, score via UI.fmt or '—'. Rows use mouse_filter PASS and have NO tap handler (no player card).

Tournament rules popup text is hard-coded: '20 игроков', 'Топ-5 поднимаются…последние 5 опускаются', the rewards line from the current league's gems, and last week from history. Prize row text: 'Приз топ-3 группы', 'Топ-5 идут выше, последние 5 ниже'. Event and tournament strings are hard-coded, not in V6Txt.

Event screen layout: show_chrome(true, true). Header card Rect2(16,124,W-32,252) with tag 'ИВЕНТ · 2 НЕДЕЛИ', the event name as a 38 px title, 'До конца', the heroine avatar and bonus text, the currency pill top-right, and '?' at bottom-right → _rules. Tabs Карта/Лавка/Вехи at y=390, h 66. Body Control at y=470, height H-470-136. Map: 12 nodes in a 3-column snake; tapping a node opens table_popup (Common.popup 'Стол N', h 640) → 'Играть' → main.go('v7play', {mode:'v7event', node, partner}).

No back button on either screen and no header row with back/title/help: the global topbar (avatar, rank, currencies) stays on top and the navbar at the bottom. The way out is the navbar (e.g. 'Чайная'). In-game result overlays have their own buttons: 'К карте ивента' / 'Следующий стол' and 'К турниру' / 'Ещё раз'. Nothing in scripts/ handles NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST or ui_cancel, so Android back uses Godot's default (quit).

Popups darken the header: Common.popup adds its root to main.overlay. overlay is added after topbar and navbar in main._ready, so the 0.72 dim covers the topbar too. Every event and tournament popup (intro, table, rules, results) therefore darkens the header.

Window over window: (1) on first visit of a cycle the event screen schedules _intro_popup after a 0.5 s timer, and show_pending uses a 1.0 s timer. Neither checks for an existing popup. If the player taps a node (table_popup) or '?' (_rules) within that time, a second full popup with its own dim is stacked on top. (2) The event screen is itself drawn as a framed card (looks like a window) under the topbar, and every action opens another framed popup on it. (3) Common.popup has no 'one popup at a time' guard; go() only clears existing popups on navigation.

In-play strip for v7tourney shows trophy, 'ОЧКИ' and the live score, plus 'Лучший: N · L.short' in the league color. The result overlay shows the place in the group with ▲ delta and zone text. Both use LEAGUES / zone().

Selftest (--event_selftest=1) solves all event and tournament boards for 8 weeks and prints bot scores at week end (rows[0], rows[4], rows[14] from group(t, 1.0)). It depends on group() returning at least 15 rows.

maps.summary: The recovered source holds only the table's headless engine: rules and scoring (mj.gd), the round state machine (round.gd), the AI (ai.gd) and a SceneTree selftest. Nothing in the source or the 0.7 APK draws the table. There is no lobby screen, no table screen, no main.gd route, no entry on the modes screen, no save keys, no table rank ladder (Ученица…Небожитель), no placement points (+30/+10/-10/-30) and no rank-gated rooms. A 12-game all-AI simulation stays zero-sum: no zero-sum or total-score check failed. There are 3 subs (I-III) except Небожитель, which is open-ended. rank_of(rp), rank_title, rank_index, and add_rp(n) returns rank-ups and grants gems (tier gems at sub 0, else 50*(tier+1)). Round setup options: seed, length ('east' = tonpuusen, 'south' = hanchan), players (array of dicts {id, ctl, style?}), start (default 25000), dealer (random 0-3). ctl != 'ai' makes a seat human: the engine returns ask events and waits for answer().

Engine API for a UI. advance() steps the state machine and returns events: deal, draw, discard, call, riichi_stick, win, draw_end, ask (kind turn/call/chankan), noop, match_end. answer(dict) resumes after an ask. turn_options(s) and call_options(o) give the legal actions. Signal said(seat, what) is declared but never emitted.

Match end and placements. _next_hand ends the match when any score < 0, when the last wind has passed, or on agari-yame (the dealer wins the last hand while on top). Leftover riichi sticks go to 1st place. placements() sorts by score, ties broken by seat order from start_dealer. final_result() returns {order, place[4] (1..4 per seat), scores, seed, log_size}. No placement-points / uma / oka / rank-points logic exists anywhere.

Win/draw payouts are standard. Ron +300/honba, tsumo +100/honba per payer, sticks x1000 to the winner. Exhaustive draw: 3000 noten payment split between tenpai and noten seats; honba+1; dealer keeps on tenpai. No nagashi or abortive draws.

Scoring: 27 yaku + 12 yakuman with Russian names/hints, dora/aka (tiles 16, 52, 88 = red 5m/5p/5s)/ura, fu calculation, limit names (Манган…Якуман) and payments(). Rules: kuikae ban, furiten (permanent, temporary, riichi), chankan, rinshan, up to 4 kans/5 dora indicators, riichi requires 1000 points and wall >= 4.

AI styles per heroine id: coach, mc 'Ровный ветер', rin 'Тихая церемония', hana 'Эстафета', yue 'Лунная тень', nova 'Оверклок', each with call/riichi/defense/skill/value/speed. static var room_skill = 1.0 scales skill and defense, the intended hook for room difficulty but nothing sets it. A player dict may also pass a custom 'style'. coach(r, s) gives a hint discard for the human.
Tile art for the table: t00..t36.png at 144x200 (34 kinds plus aka 34/35/36, mapped by V8Mj.face()), back.png 144x200, glow.png 184x240, shadow.png 168x224. Nothing references it yet.

Hand-size constraint: up to 14 closed tiles across a 720 px width with 16 px gutters gives ~688/14 = 49 px per tile (scale ~0.34 of the 144 px art) in a single row. This explains the 'рука мелкая' complaint. The engine exposes everything a center plaque needs (round_name(), wall_left(), dora_ind, honba, sticks, scores, seat_wind()) for the 'центр стола пустой' complaint.

Selftest invocation: selftest.gd extends SceneTree and runs from _init. Invoke it as: godot --headless --path game -s res://scripts/v08/table/selftest.gd -- --games=N (default 12). _arg reads OS.get_cmdline_user_args() for --key=value. It prints PASS/FAIL lines, SIM stats and 'TABLE SELFTEST OK|FAILED n', then quits. This is NOT the main.gd '--selftest=…' arg, which runs the tray-level solver (_selftest over G.LEVELS x5). The event selftest is --event_selftest=1. Godot binary in this environment: /opt/tw-tools/godot (4.5.1).

Running it verbatim (on a scratch copy of the repo) fails to compile. Godot 4.5.1 errors: selftest.gd:61 'var w: = parse(win)[0]' cannot infer type; mj.gd:284 'var j: = k + d' cannot infer type; round.gd:235 'var k: = t >> 2' cannot infer type; round.gd:370 'var can: = not ev.is_empty() and …' cannot infer type; round.gd:445 'V8AI.call(self, o, opts)' gives 'Could not resolve external class member call' (the static func ai.gd:272 named call collides with Object.call). The main game loads with no parse errors because nothing references V8*.

With those 5 lines patched in scratch (explicit int/bool types; call renamed to call_decide), --games=12 gives 96 hands (12 draws), 14248 steps, max_step_ms=162 on desktop, 25 s total. All zero-sum and 100000-total checks pass. Average places: mc 2.44, hana 2.30, yue 2.90, nova 2.40, rin 2.44. Result: 'TABLE SELFTEST FAILED 5'.

All 5 selftest failures are wrong tests, not engine bugs. (1) The '6-shanten worst-ish' hand 159m159p159s1234z has kokushi shanten 3, so >=5 is wrong. (2-4) The 'riichi pinfu tsumo' hand 234m567p234s56788s winning on 8s can only read as a tanki wait (5678s nobetan), so no pinfu: 30 fu and base 960 are correct. (5) In 'toitoi chun honroutou' the 3 closed triplets on tsumo correctly add sanankou. Separately, the 'iipeikou riichi dora2' closed string 22m345p345p66s789s has only 13 tiles, so evaluate() returns {} and a runtime error on .han aborts _score_tests.
No table data is saved: G.default_state() has no table keys (only rp, which is unified). No --pt= playtest runner exists in the recovered source.

maps.summary: The game has no single dev-flag registry. Each script reads OS.get_cmdline_user_args() itself, and most turn "--k=v" tokens into a dictionary. That means flags with no "=" (for example --selftest or --shots) are ignored by those dictionary parsers. A few flags are checked by substring or exact token instead (--demo, --splash, --fresh, the "--shots" check in _splash). The plan's "--pt=" playtest script is NOT in the source anywhere: it was lost along with the 0.8 work (docs/STATE.md says so). _dev_args() is called at the end of main._ready (main.gd:76). It parses only tokens that start with '--' and contain '='; key=substr(2) up to the first '=' (main.gd:339-342). Flags: --unlock=N sets G.S.unlocked=N, and with it --free (any value) sets free10, --pity=N, --ex=N (main.gd:343-347). --modest=any sets G.S.modest=true (348-349). --outfit=ITEM_ID owns and equips the outfit and makes its hero the partner (350-354). --fuzz=N (355-357) and --selftest=N (358-360) both return early. --screen=ID [--level=N] [--auto=any] [--mode=M] calls go(screen,{level,auto,mode}) after one frame with busy forced false (361-367). Valid IDs are the keys of main.gd SCREENS (12-25): home, levels, play, summon, collection, shop, modes, arena, room, v7event, v7tourney, v7play. --shots=DIR [--at=t1,t2,...] [--act=a1,a2,...] [--name=prefix] (368-381): --at times are absolute seconds (default '2'). Before shot i it calls screen.dev_act(act[i]) ('-' or empty = none), waits 0.05s, saves DIR/<name>_<i>.png (default name 'shot'), then quits after the last shot.

_splash flag handling: it joins the args into one string and substring-tests it. If '--shots' is present and '--splash' is not, the title splash is skipped. '--splash' forces the splash and sets G.S.intro_done = ('--fresh' not in args), so --splash --fresh shows the first-launch path (V6Story.play('intro') followed by tutorial level 0). The title version text comes from V6Txt 'title.version' = 'версия 0.6 · без жизней и навязчивой рекламы' (hard-coded). In the 720x1280 shot the heroine's legs partly cover that version label.

--fuzz=N: V7Fuzz.run(host, N). For each of the 48 levels, N reps: a V6SpecialBoard with specials plan_for(cfg,''), random play (3% shuffle_board, 3% force-remove a pair, 2% undo, otherwise take a free tile preferring tray matches), one 3-tile rescue. It checks odd face counts, orphans and 'no free tile', then printerrs 'FUZZ <games> games: rule errors X, blocked takes Y, cleared Z, lost W' and quits. Usage: godot --headless --path . -- --fuzz=5. RESULT (N=5): 'FUZZ 240 games: rule errors 0, blocked takes 0, cleared 107, lost 133', exit 0, 10.5s. BUT there are 5 SCRIPT ERRORs 'Out of bounds get index 100' at G.tile_tex (g.gd:392) via tile.set_face (tile.gd:218), reached from special_board._joker_turn (special_board.gd:285) and from shuffle_board->reassign_faces (tray_board.gd:677). Face 100 is the shard-tile face assigned at tray_board.gd:236-237. tile.gd:97 guards it ('face if face < 36 else 0') but set_face at tile.gd:218 does not. A joker that takes a shard's face then fails on texture load.

--event_selftest=1 (exact token): autoload V7Event._ready schedules _selftest.call_deferred(). It solves every event node cfg (V7EventData.EVENTS x NODES) plus 8 weeks x V7Ladder.TABLES tourney tables with the solver, then prints the week par and bot scores of the tourney group (V7Ladder.group). Usage: godot --headless --path . -- --event_selftest=1. RESULT: 'EVENT SELFTEST 84/84 boards solved · week par 1118/1082/1352 · bots at week end: top 2644, 5th 2298, 15th 274', exit 0, 3.3s.

Riichi table selftest: scripts/v08/table/selftest.gd extends SceneTree (script mode) and takes --games=N (default 12) through _arg() (selftest.gd:14-18). RESULT: FAILS TO LOAD in 0.18s with 'Parse Error: Cannot infer the type of "w" variable' at selftest.gd:61 ('var w: = parse(win)[0]'). filled.finding: Nothing in the codebase uses LineEdit or clipboard_get. The only share path is photo.gd:400-416: DisplayServer.clipboard_set(caption) plus OS.shell_open(path), followed by a toast telling the user to share from the gallery. Android export has gradle_build/use_gradle_build=false (export_presets.cfg:24), so no Android plugin (native share sheet, QR scanner) can be added without switching to a gradle build. The realistic no-server channel is: export with DisplayServer.clipboard_set, import with DisplayServer.clipboard_get() behind a 'Вставить код' button, plus an optional LineEdit. Given the 0.8-2.8 KB code size, that rules out a short typed code unless a compact binary format is designed.

Verified: 'title.version' is referenced only at main.gd:117; there are no other version readers. In Godot 4.x the Android preset's version/name, when left empty, falls back to application/config/version (worth confirming in the 4.5.1 docs). So the single-source fix is: set config/version="0.8.0" in project.godot [application] and clear version/name in export_presets.cfg:33, rather than keeping two copies. version/code=8 (line 32) remains a separate integer.
